nav.home: Pilih Jobs, go to the board

signIn.title: Every application, one board
signIn.intro: Track the jobs you apply to and see what needs you next.
signIn.emailHelp: We email you a sign-in link. No password.
signIn.sentTo: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
signIn.linkLifetime: The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
signIn.footnote: Pilih Jobs keeps your applications private to your account. Signing in uses the same account as the CV, invoice and portfolio builders.

errors.expiredTitle: That sign-in link no longer works

errors.session_expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

pauseReasons.captcha_or_challenge: Complete the check in the browser window yourself.
pauseReasons.login_required: Log in in the browser window, then resume.

pauseReasons.mfa_required: Finish the sign-in step in the browser window, then resume.
pauseReasons.credential_field: Fill the password field yourself, then resume.
pauseReasons.missing_information: An answer is missing: check Approvals.

pauseReasons.unknown_question: A question needs your answer: check Approvals.
pauseReasons.unsupported_form: This form isn't supported. Take over in the browser, or cancel.
pauseReasons.unclear_page: The page was unclear. Take over in the browser, or cancel.

pauseReasons.stuck_loop: The run stopped repeating itself. Take over, or cancel.

pauseReasons.network_offline: The device went offline. Resume when it's back.
pauseReasons.resource_exhausted: The run hit its limits. Resume or cancel.
pauseReasons.low_confidence: The agent wasn't sure enough. Take over, or cancel.
pauseReasons.injection_suspected: The page contained suspicious instructions. Review it before resuming.
pauseReasons.ai_unavailable: AI help is unavailable right now. Resume later.
